note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), read offline from the bundled owb-am text, per the founder decision of 2026-11-18 that every Amharic work quotes OWB. Every quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim, replacing the 1962 UBS wording (and the OT renderings made in its register). The book quotes whole verses in its chapters and repeats them in its closing Scripture index; each verse now reads identically in the chapter and in the index.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse or range, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…' where the English elides (Acts 16:13, Luke 18:1, Joshua 24:15, Philippians 4:11-12, Hebrews 11:33-34). Where OWB's wording changed a word the author's next sentence picks up, that sentence follows OWB: Matthew 6:6's room is «ውስጠኛ ክፍል», Colossians 4:2's devotion «ሳታቋርጡ», Philippians 4:7's peace is «ከማስተዋል ሁሉ በላይ», Luke 10:2's harvest «አዝመራ», Psalm 23:4's rod and staff «ዱላና ምርኩዝ … ልብ ሰጥተዋታል», 2 Corinthians 5:14's love «ወደ ፊት ገፋፋት», Psalm 121:2's help «እርዳታ», and Matthew 7:8's door «በሩ». The index's Psalm 56:8 drops its '(NLT)' tag, which named the English edition's Bible.
